transcription.text: [Music]
[Music]
English students book 3b
Page 1. Unit 1.
How do we spend our free time?
Page 2. Get ready.
A. Listen. Then point and say... 1. I can read. 2. I can sing.
3. I can paint. 4. I can dance. 5. I can swim.
6. I can play basketball. 7. I can play ping pong. 8. I can play
football.
Page 3. See. Listen and say... 1. I dance with my friends after school.
2. I read with my mother every day. 3. I play basketball with my father
every Saturday.
4. I play football after school. Page 4. Explore. What are your hobbies?
Hello children. Let's talk about hobbies. What do you like doing in
your free time?
I like singing and dancing. I like music. This is me in my dance class.
Look at my purple skirt.
Page 5. I like reading. I like painting too. This is me in my favourite
park.
I like playing ping pong and riding my bike. This is me on my bike. I
like swimming. I like playing basketball too. This is me in a game.
P... p... park. B... b... bike.
Page 7. See. Listen and chant. My hobby.
On Saturday what do you like doing? I like painting. How about you? I
paint cats and rabbits too. It's a hobby and fun to do.
On Sunday what do you like doing? I like swimming. How about you? I
swim in the pool and in the sea. I swim here and there and feel so free.
Learn. What do you like doing? I like running.
Page 8. Communicate. A. Listen and tick. Then act. Hi, I'm Susu. Hi, I'm
Fei-Fei. This is my friend, Yun-Yun. Let's have fun together.
Yun-Yun, what do you like doing in your free time? I like dancing. I
like playing football too. How about you, Fei-Fei? I like reading. I
like playing basketball too.
I want to go swimming this afternoon. Fei-Fei and I can swim. Swimming
is fun. Great. Cool. Let's go swimming together.
Page 10. Extend. Ben and Bob. One. It's warm and sunny. I like sleeping.
What do you like doing, Ben? I like working.
Two. It's hot. I like dancing. Come and dance. Sorry, Bob. I have work
to do.
Three. The weather is cool. I like singing. Come here, Ben. No, I have
to get some food.
Four. It's cold today. I like reading at home. It's nice and warm. It's
so cold. I have no food. I have no home.
Five. Come in. You can share my food. Thank you. I'll get food next
year.
